initial_observation: IF a specific OFAC identity and its dated restriction have independently been established, and a USAspending recipient may be that entity.
expected_observation: THEN retrieve the recipient’s individual dated contract actions and distinguish new obligations from termination, correction or administrative modifications. Award totals are not amounts spent during the search interval.
operational_join: OFAC ProfileID identifies an OFAC profile; USAspending Recipient UEI identifies a procurement entity. No shared UEI is established in the OFAC schema. Resolve registration/address/identity first. Use generated_internal_id to request transaction history.
historical_scope: Live search warns that its time filters begin 2007-10-01; older data need documented downloads. One 2025 search returned an award starting in 2016. Its oldest action was 2016. Restriction dates must come from dated OFAC actions/history.
consequential_finding_and_basis: Actual post-restriction public contracting could be consequential; the observed sample proves only access and action-field semantics, not a sanctions match.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: Dated OFAC list/actions and governing program
Recipient legal registration and any ownership bridge
Complete award action history and underlying contract/payment records
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Namesake, listed parent rather than recipient, pre-listing conduct, termination, zero/new negative obligation, authorized transaction. The one response has null action-type fields: missing classification is not new activity.
next_cheapest_check: Inspect one action description and amount definition; resolve identity before expanding a candidate.
source_specific_priority_reason: High consequence plus demonstrated award-to-action retrieval; still labor-intensive identity/legal work. Higher priority than vessel portals whose storage rights are unresolved.
reviewer: same model session; independent reviewer comments addressed separately

initial_observation: IF a blocked vessel has a verified ship IMO and dated designation.
expected_observation: THEN a dated Paris MoU inspection could establish a port encounter, not cargo or prohibited trade. Do not build a stored automated inspection dataset under the permissions presently verified.
operational_join: Exact ship IMO, not IMO company number; port/date/report identify an inspection event.
historical_scope: Public search exposes period filters, but retained historical coverage was not sampled or established.
consequential_finding_and_basis: A post-designation inspection at a relevant port gives a precise follow-up event, but its investigative value depends on cargo, operator and applicable restriction.
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Rescue/safety visit, authorized activity, inaccurate IMO, inspection without trade. The public search displays a system error; no records were collected.
next_cheapest_check: Obtain documented permission or a lawful agency-provided single report before storing records.
source_specific_priority_reason: Stable IMO is attractive but the permission barrier defeats a tier-1 cheap-automation ranking.
reviewer: same model session; independent reviewer comments addressed separately

initial_observation: IF an identified restricted vessel needs its owner/manager and safety history checked.
expected_observation: THEN Equasis may provide provider-attributed ship context after registration; it is not independently verified evidence of a new voyage.
operational_join: Ship IMO links vessel context; separate owner, manager and ISM company roles and each provider’s timestamp.
historical_scope: Historical snapshot coverage not confirmed. Current ship data cannot be projected backward.
consequential_finding_and_basis: A documented ownership/management change may sharpen asset tracing; an Equasis appearance alone cannot establish sanctions evasion.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: Dated primary registry documents and actual activity evidence
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Free access is not unrestricted redistribution. Historic or stale manager/owner records, provider disagreements and lawful vessel activity are plausible.
next_cheapest_check: Read the terms for the exact provider’s fields and obtain the needed official registry extract.
source_specific_priority_reason: Useful manual reference; lower priority for cheap downloadable reproduction because registration and provider restrictions remain unresolved.

initial_observation: IF an OFAC identity can independently be linked to a UK company’s PSC notification.
expected_observation: THEN read the actual nature-of-control category and notification history, rather than converting PSC presence into a blocked ownership percentage.
operational_join: Company number scopes the company; PSC notification IDs identify records, not global persons. Corporate PSC registration authority/number can help identity. Individual names and partial DOB remain provisional.
historical_scope: API docs describe notified_on and ceased_on as notification dates. These are not automatically dates ownership began or ended.
consequential_finding_and_basis: An actual ownership chain reaching an unlisted subsidiary could matter; a 25–50% band does not resolve a 50% threshold and control categories can be non-ownership.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: API key or lawful public filing retrieval
Underlying effective ownership dates and precise shares where threshold-relevant
Aggregation without double counting and program-specific legal analysis
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Voting rights, significant influence and directorship are not ownership; protected PSC details may be absent; dates may reflect filing lag.
next_cheapest_check: Read one PSC notification category and underlying filing before attempting any 50% calculation.
source_specific_priority_reason: High consequence but exact identity, dates and share ranges are unresolved; official schema improves diagnosis, not executable status.

initial_observation: IF a Crossref work supplies an explicit ClinicalTrials.gov registry ID and NCT identifier.
expected_observation: THEN resolve that NCT to the registry before comparing the publication’s claims against prospectively recorded outcomes. The current registry response is not the original protocol.
operational_join: Crossref clinical-trial-number plus registry DOI 10.18810/clinical-trials-gov; normalize nct prefix to uppercase and validate eight digits. Sample lowercase nct04967326 resolved to NCT04967326.
historical_scope: Crossref publication dates and registry first-posted, study-start, completion and update dates differ. Historical outcome versions have not been retrieved.
consequential_finding_and_basis: Unexplained outcome switching or selective reporting can affect treatment evidence, but the technical sample is only a linkage test and is not scored as a research-integrity finding.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: Dated protocol and statistical analysis plan
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Retrospective registration can be openly disclosed; publication can be a secondary analysis; amended outcomes can be justified. Missing Crossref trial metadata is not missing publication evidence.
next_cheapest_check: Use the explicit deposited trial ID; retrieve the earliest relevant registry version before reading any apparent outcome discrepancy.
source_specific_priority_reason: A reliable small free identifier route was demonstrated; substantive checking still requires historical and full-text evidence absent from the two API responses.
reviewer: same model session; independent reviewer comments addressed separately

initial_observation: IF a US GHGRP facility reports methane for a specified year and Carbon Mapper observes a plausibly attributable methane source during that year.
expected_observation: THEN compare compatible source-emission estimates and annual reports only after testing attribution, units and observation representativeness.
operational_join: GHGRP facility ID is not Carbon Mapper source ID. Required bridge is a verified facility footprint/source-origin mapping with uncertainty; nearest point alone is insufficient.
historical_scope: EPA page advertises 2023 as latest public year; verify actual selected release. Carbon Mapper instantaneous plumes must fall in that year and cannot alone supply annual totals.
consequential_finding_and_basis: A repeated, well-supported reporting discrepancy could expose a significant emissions problem, while a single overpass cannot.
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Intermittent emissions, adjacent source, reporting thresholds, annualization bias, model uncertainty and changing reporting scope. STAC/scoped access requires an account; no account created.
next_cheapest_check: Check whether a matching year has enough actual observations before downloading any plume collection.
source_specific_priority_reason: High consequence but spatial attribution and sampling model dominate cost; not a direct-ID or simple subtraction test.
reviewer: same model session; independent reviewer comments addressed separately

initial_observation: IF an EPA ECHO facility has a documented hazard and verified site boundary.
expected_observation: THEN Google Open Buildings footprints can indicate mapped structures inside a justified impact area; report structures, not residents.
operational_join: Intersect validated building polygons and hazard footprint in compatible CRS. ECHO coordinates alone are not the hazard boundary.
historical_scope: Building imagery vintage and facility/hazard date must overlap; the catalog’s geometry/confidence fields do not establish current occupancy.
consequential_finding_and_basis: Previously overlooked structures near a hazard could justify checking evacuation and monitoring plans. This is a built-environment screen, not a population-exposure estimate.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: Building classification and occupancy evidence if people are counted
Site boundary and local imagery checks
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Nonresidential/empty buildings, false detections, outdated construction and no exposure pathway.
next_cheapest_check: Validate several building polygons and their use before making any population statement.
source_specific_priority_reason: Lower source-specific consequence than a validated population model: the observation establishes structures only, despite the inherited family score of94.
reviewer: same model session; independent reviewer comments addressed separately

initial_observation: IF an ECHO facility has a documented hazard footprint and relevant date.
expected_observation: THEN a compatible WorldPop population surface may estimate modeled residents in that footprint, with uncertainty and no claim of dose.
operational_join: Integrate population-cell counts or density correctly over overlap; do not sum density values or treat grid centroids as all-or-nothing residents.
historical_scope: Match population reference year, boundaries and facility operation; a historical population surface is not a current census.
consequential_finding_and_basis: A defensible estimate of potentially affected residents can sharpen monitoring and preparedness reporting; it is materially different from counting buildings.
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Census undercount, allocation model bias, evacuation, stale population, inappropriate geographic coverage. Population presence is not injury.
next_cheapest_check: Confirm whether the selected raster stores people per cell or density and inspect one cell against metadata.
source_specific_priority_reason: Higher potential than footprint-only R07 but also a larger methodological burden; no product sample or exposure model validated yet.
reviewer: same model session; independent reviewer comments addressed separately

initial_observation: IF a tailings facility has a plausible, independently documented failure scenario.
expected_observation: THEN determine whether a routed downstream flow path reaches a dam/reservoir and whether the scenario could affect its operation.
operational_join: Tailings location → terrain/drainage network (SYS0182 or appropriate local DEM) → downstream dam asset. This is directed hydrological routing, not generic polygon intersection.
historical_scope: Use terrain, engineered diversions, facility designs and operating conditions valid for the scenario date; select HydroSHEDS version/coverage explicitly.
consequential_finding_and_basis: A credible cascade could create catastrophic downstream risk, but two facility points cannot establish it.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: Breach volume/material and engineering failure scenario
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Separate catchments, engineered barriers/diversions, bad coordinates, unsuitable northern-latitude data, insufficient breach energy.
next_cheapest_check: Check catchment connectivity and terrain quality before calculating any consequence.
source_specific_priority_reason: Potential consequence very high; expert and multi-source costs make it unsuitable as an easy two-table join.
reviewer: same model session; independent reviewer comments addressed separately

initial_observation: IF a non-EU reporter’s UN Comtrade record reports imports from a specified EU member for product/period P.
expected_observation: THEN compare EU-member-reported exports to that non-EU partner in Comext for harmonized P (or the exact reciprocal direction for non-EU exports).
operational_join: Explicit reporter/partner reversal; flow reversal; HS↔CN vintage concordance; same units and period. Never compare the same reporter data redistributed in two portals as independent evidence.
historical_scope: Comext advertises monthly/annual files from1988. Comtrade posting is reporter-dependent; verify both reporters’ common periods and revision dates.
consequential_finding_and_basis: A reconciled residual may identify trade-route or statistical questions, not a firm’s smuggling or evasion.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: CIF/FOB, re-export, confidentiality and lag reconciliation
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Same upstream observation twice, code revisions, freight/insurance, transit, confidential cells, unmatched time windows.
next_cheapest_check: Write out two reporter/partner/flow tuples before downloading one compatible cell from each source.
source_specific_priority_reason: Official coverage supports this corrected direction; public API root404 is not evidence the dataset is inaccessible. No bilateral data comparison executed.

initial_observation: IF a World Bank project records an approved objective, financing amount or revised closing date.
expected_observation: THEN retrieve project-linked agreements, implementation reports and evaluations to determine which original commitments changed and whether the reasons are disclosed.
operational_join: Documents API projectid matches Projects API id in the P###### namespace. One document→project link was demonstrated; document type selects the required evidence rather than treating every PDF as an audit.
historical_scope: Sample document metadata has a future docdt relative to retrieval; chronology must come from signed document text. Project API status/closing date can also lag.
consequential_finding_and_basis: Changed public commitments or repeatedly deferred delivery can be consequential, but a linked agreement or revision alone is ordinary administration.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: Actual output evidence and agency explanation
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Routine extension, legitimate scope change, stale metadata, currency/commitment versus disbursement. A document date in the index is not verified event time.
next_cheapest_check: Fetch one project-linked document and read its type and internal date before constructing a chronology.
source_specific_priority_reason: High cheap-reproduction value: stable project key and two public APIs demonstrated; the substantive comparison still requires full documents, not metadata alone.

initial_observation: IF existing OONI Web Connectivity measurements show persistent domain-specific anomalies on one ASN and time interval.
expected_observation: THEN identify the network and inspect anomaly/control evidence across dates and comparison networks; distinguish interference from a general outage.
operational_join: OONI probe_asn AS21928 → RIPEstat resource21928 after validated AS-prefix normalization. Measurement UID, input URL and test_name define the observation; do not infer user identity.
historical_scope: One historical RIPE query returned a stale-data warning. Confirm the holder’s effective period and OONI timestamp boundary behavior before attributing an event.
consequential_finding_and_basis: Persistent selective blocking of public-interest information can be consequential. An anomaly alone is not censorship, and network ownership does not establish who ordered it.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: Repeated observations and independent policy/technical evidence
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Server failure, CDN/geolocation differences, captive portal, measurement bugs, weak coverage. Sample metadata is unverified; no active tests or volunteer requests initiated.
next_cheapest_check: Review error/control fields and timestamp semantics in a few existing measurements, then establish historical ASN attribution.
source_specific_priority_reason: Recovers an omitted censorship mechanism while preserving rejection of the earlier generic-outage interpretation. Small linkage works; historical attribution is not certified.

initial_observation: IF a US power plant has reported generation and GHGRP emissions for the same period.
expected_observation: THEN reconcile generation and combustion/emissions boundaries to test whether an unusual emissions intensity has a documented operational explanation.
operational_join: EPA advertises a GHGRP→EIA plant-ID crosswalk. Use that versioned bridge, not plant names; aggregate generators only to the emissions reporting boundary.
historical_scope: EIA documents monthly plant generation; GHGRP is annual and release lag matters. Restrict to a common verified reporting year.
consequential_finding_and_basis: An unexplained intensity change may reveal fuel-switching, controls or reporting problems; it is not direct proof of underreporting.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: Same gas, heat input and emissions units
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: CHP allocation, multiple generators, outages, fuel mix, gross versus net generation, boundary changes. EIA API needs a key; no key created.
next_cheapest_check: Inspect one official crosswalk row and definitions before choosing a plant-year.
source_specific_priority_reason: Better grounded than an arbitrary spatial join because a publisher-provided bridge exists, but API access and boundary reconciliation remain to be sampled.

next_cheapest_check: Check that the selected unit is actually published individually before requesting access or historical data.
source_specific_priority_reason: Potentially strong falsifiable observation but presently blocked by credentials and an unproven plant-to-unit bridge.

initial_observation: IF a state-submitted UNOOSA record makes a specific dated statement about an identifiable space object.
expected_observation: THEN orbital data for the exact object may test a physical claim consistent with the supported model; it cannot establish ownership or military purpose.
operational_join: Full international designator including piece suffix, e.g.1998-067A, not launch prefix1998-067. CelesTrak INTDES queries return all launch objects; match OBJECT_ID after retrieval.
historical_scope: One current epoch was sampled. Historical orbit claims need historical elements and SGP4-compatible propagation; current elements cannot reconstruct arbitrary past states.
consequential_finding_and_basis: A clear discrepancy between an official physical-status account and observations may warrant follow-up; absence from UNOOSA does not establish a registration breach.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: Actual state submission, not square-bracket supplemental index facts
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Debris or nonfunctional objects excluded by the index, registration lag, maneuvers, wrong piece suffix, modeled orbit uncertainty.
next_cheapest_check: Find the actual state submission and verify its designator before any orbital comparison.
source_specific_priority_reason: Concrete shared namespace recovers an omission; present evidence supports only one side and no legal or mission inference.

initial_observation: IF a SEDI insider transaction identifies a security class, transaction date and insider/issuer.
expected_observation: THEN align it with a specific SEDAR+ issuer disclosure/event and determine whether corporate actions or ordinary compensation explain the trade.
operational_join: Insider and issuer profiles plus security class; issuer-name similarity alone is provisional. Corporate actions and amended holdings must reconcile.
historical_scope: SEDI distinguishes transaction dates from filing dates and excludes pre-launch paper filings from electronic results. Broad queries can truncate.
consequential_finding_and_basis: Unusual trading around a material announcement can motivate further reporting, but timing does not establish possession/use of inside information.

Applicable securities law before any allegation

next_cheapest_check: Use one narrow issuer/date search and verify transaction code and corporate actions.
source_specific_priority_reason: Potentially consequential omitted source, but manual interface and disclosure chronology prevent a cheap automated-readiness claim.

initial_observation: IF a published federal Information Commissioner order directs a particular institution to act.
expected_observation: THEN identify any Federal Court review of that same order and obtain evidence of compliance with the operative obligation.
operational_join: Order citation, institution, request/matter and court file; institution/date coincidence alone cannot establish a linked judicial review.
historical_scope: Decision database is selected published decisions; dates are decision dates. Service, review proceedings and any stay/changed obligation must be established from documents.
consequential_finding_and_basis: Failure to implement an operative disclosure order could matter to public accountability. The database does not itself prove compliance or noncompliance.
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Court review, stay, varied order, release outside public registry, incomplete published court corpus. No absence-of-appeal inference from RSS search.
next_cheapest_check: Read the order and seek a court-file reference or institution response before judging delay.
source_specific_priority_reason: An omitted accountability route with official legal context, but it requires matter-specific records and cannot use publication absence as noncompliance.

initial_observation: IF a particular financial institution’s identity and OFAC restriction are independently verified.
expected_observation: THEN monthly IRS FFI listings may show its GIIN registration status, which can prompt a narrowly framed administrative question—not a finding that banking transactions continued.
operational_join: GIIN identifies FFI registrations/branches; no common GIIN in the OFAC sample schema is demonstrated. Confirm branch versus legal entity and independent registration identity.
historical_scope: IRS publishes monthly approved-status lists with a cutoff before month-start and provides historical files; first appearance is not necessarily approval date.
consequential_finding_and_basis: A documented inconsistency in administrative treatment might warrant questions, but a FATCA listing is neither a banking licence nor sanctions clearance.
mandatory_auxiliary_inputs: Dated monthly lists and cutoff metadata
Actual financial activity for any transaction allegation
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: FATCA status serves a different legal purpose; historic listing, branch mismatch, list lag, authorized activity. Official example file is synthetic, not evidence about a real institution.
next_cheapest_check: Determine whether the proposed question concerns tax registration or actual banking; reject the latter if the only observation is FFI presence.
source_specific_priority_reason: OFAC-outward omission investigated, but downgraded because the source does not observe the high-consequence activity originally tempting to infer.
reviewer: same model session; independent reviewer comments addressed separately
